meta.title: AgentBridge — Codebase Explorer Workflow
meta.subtitle: Sandboxed Mobile Code Review and Codebase Exploration Flow
meta.description: Decision and execution workflow guiding mobile operators from project selection through sandboxed directory exploration, file classification, bounded previewing, search, symbols, and secure download.

states.label: Telegram User
states.description: Operator triggers /projects or clicks 📁 Projects on Telegram navigation keyboard.

states.label: Select Project
states.description: Select an authorized discovered project from the registered workspaces list.

states.label: Browse Directory
states.description: Paginated, lazy directory traversal strictly bounded within authorized workspace root.

states.label: Select File
states.description: Operator selects a file entry from paginated directory screen.

states.label: Authorization / Sandbox Check
states.description: Verifies target path is inside workspace, not sensitive (.env, keys), and symlinks do not escape.

states.label: File Classification
states.description: Probes 8KB header and extension to classify as binary or text.

states.label: Binary File Information
states.description: Displays MIME type, category, file size, and provides secure download button.

states.label: Text File Information
states.description: Displays language, total line count, size, timestamp, and actions (Preview, Symbols, Search, Download).

states.label: Bounded Code Preview
states.description: Default 35-line bounded code window with exact line numbers, syntax highlighting, and secret redaction.

states.label: Preview Actions (Next / Prev / Jump / Search / Symbols / Download)
states.description: Interactive tools: pagination, jumping to target line, text search, AST symbol navigation, or redacted export.

states.label: Secure Download
states.description: Streams redacted text export or safe binary attachment within size limits.
